scorecard.name: Hold time and Dead Air
scorecard.coaching: The agent had two unmanaged hold violations: at [04:56] the customer had to chase after a 65-second silence ('Hello? Are you still there, Nadia?'), and at [10:44] the second hold lasted 135 seconds, exceeding the 120-second maximum exempt hold limit.

scorecard.name: Active listening
scorecard.coaching: At [06:58], the agent asked whether the customer was testing over Wi-Fi or with an Ethernet cable, despite the customer explicitly stating at [01:03] that his laptop was plugged directly into yellow port one with a Cat6 Ethernet cable and Wi-Fi was switched off.

scorecard.name: Confirmed the issue is resolved
scorecard.coaching: At [06:43] and [10:44], the broadband upstream fault remained unresolved at 512 kbps due to an external copper shunt fault requiring an Openreach street cabinet engineer visit on Thursday morning.

grader.scenario: Broadband upload speed collapsed to 0.4 Mbps causing video calls to freeze while working from home
grader.notes: STT-rough broadband upload fault call where Nadia passes 8 criteria including proactive ownership (booking Openreach and adding a free unlimited 5G tethering pass), but fails Dead Air (two subtle hold violations: customer chasing after a 65s hold at [04:56], and a second hold of 135s > 120s max at [10:44]), Active Listening (asking Wi-Fi vs Ethernet at [06:58] after Raghav stated Cat6 Ethernet at [01:03]), and Resolution (requires Thursday Openreach cabinet visit).

items.name: Branding and Survey Check
items.evidence: [00:00] Agent: 'Good morning, um, thank you for calling S-Net Broadband Technical Support...' and [13:55] Agent: 'Thank you for choosing S-Net...'

items.name: Hold time and Dead Air
items.evidence: [03:41]-[04:56]: 65s gap where Customer breaks silence with 'Hello? Are you still there, Nadia?'; [08:19]-[10:44]: 135s gap (>120s limit) before Agent returns at [10:44].

items.name: Verified customer
items.evidence: [00:36] Agent asks for home address and memorable security question within the first 4 minutes; Customer confirms both at [00:48].

items.name: Personalized the call/ticket appropriately
items.evidence: [00:16], [00:36], [01:26], [11:25] Agent addresses Raghav by name throughout.

items.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
items.evidence: [00:16] Agent: 'Oh no, I am really sorry to hear your upload speed has dropped like that, Raghav...' and [00:36]: 'I completely understand how stressful that is in the middle of client meetings, Raghav.'

items.name: Paraphrasing
items.evidence: [01:26] Agent: 'Right, so let me make sure I have got that straight, Raghav: your download speed is holding steady around fifty-two megabits per second, but since yesterday morning your upload speed has cratered to zero point four megabits per second...'

items.name: Active listening
items.evidence: [01:03] Customer: '...my Dell work laptop is plugged directly into yellow port one on the S-Net Hub with a brand-new Cat6 Ethernet cable, and Wi-Fi is switched off on the laptop.' -> [06:58] Agent: 'And, er, are you testing over Wi-Fi right now or have you got an Ethernet cable plugged in?'

items.name: Took ownership of the problem
items.evidence: [03:41], [05:49], [10:44], [11:25], [12:25] Agent runs metallic path diagnostics, attempts a DLM port bounce, books the Openreach SFI2 engineer for Thursday morning, activates a free unlimited 5G mobile hotspot pass, and schedules a Thursday follow-up call.

items.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
items.evidence: [00:16], [11:25], [13:55] Agent is polite, apologetic for her slip, and proactive in supporting Raghav's work-from-home needs.

items.name: Probing
items.evidence: [01:51], [02:15] Agent probes for master socket model (NTE5C MK4 vs microfilter), internal extension wiring, and recent thunderstorm correlation.

items.name: Confirmed the issue is resolved
items.evidence: [06:43] Agent: 'It only managed five hundred and twelve kilobits per second upstream... That confirms it is a hard physical copper fault outside your property.' [10:44]: booked Openreach visit for Thursday morning.
